oB.role: secondary: Q0 + B's 16 fresh points, B

pB.role: B: the pre-improvement pipeline (full scan, left-major order)

pF.role: single arm 2: Feistel scan order only (PR #927, run 38786433493)

pL.role: single arm 1: lift_scan canonicalizer only (PR #926, run 38776966036)

pLFaa.role: A/A control: a second candidate arm

pX.role: planted positive control: the candidate plus one discarded full-scan canonicalization per partner (the per-probe work lift_scan removed), so its probes and relation are pLF's and its time is known to be larger

rT.role: A's tuned rho (Fold/64/DP6, crypto 770f6a69; reconcile rT770), the strongest one-target rho measured at n=83; one process per primary point; gap reference and scalar cross-check

current_baseline: the two single improvements were each measured against B with the other factor at baseline (lift_scan: PR #926, branch claude/n83-liftscan @ 8f6b4057e, run 38776966036, online 1.515 [1.506, 1.525] on B's 16 fresh points; Feistel: PR #927, branch claude/n83-scan-order @ af41562e7, run 38786433493, held-out 384 ratio of means 1.45 [1.20, 1.74]). Neither was measured with the other, so the incumbent here is the better single arm on this panel, decided inside every bootstrap resample.

decision_rule.invalid: any gate, identity check or control fails, or any primary point lacks a valid row in any of the six IC arms or the tuned rho: no verdict; every row is preserved
decision_rule.primary: improvement iff the 95% lower bounds of both R_m and R_g exceed 1; regression iff both upper bounds are below 1; otherwise not_separated
decision_rule.ratchet: a primary improvement makes the lift_scan + Feistel pipeline the new n=83 one-target baseline, recorded with R_m, R_g, the S_rho delta and the tuned-rho gap
decision_rule.scope: Tier 1 instance scope, one runner. Not a claim to beat rho: the tuned-rho gap is distance remaining.
decision_rule.secondaries: the old panels, combined vs B and the slice bootstrap are reported with the same interval rule; they never change the primary verdict or the ratchet

design.host: one fresh GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 runner (Tier 1 instance scope); every run one process pinned to one execution CPU (minimum of the affinity mask), clean environment, RAYON/KIC threads 1; all arms interleaved in one job
design.process_model: each IC arm is one process per 64-point slice (17 for O): setup (index build, table load and verification, bijection self-test) once, then each target with its own one-target online interval and no target-dependent work shared between targets
design.runtime_estimate: build+tests 20-30 min; log-table check ~2 min; P: 6 x (30-35 s setup + 64 x 0.3-0.9 s) + 64 rho x 1-3 s = 8-13 min per slice, 9 slices 75-115 min; H: 4 x (30-35 s + 64 x 0.4-0.9 s) = 4-6 min per slice, 6 slices 25-35 min; O: 2 x 3-4 min; total about 2.2-3.2 h (run 38786433493: IC setup 29-31 s per process, tuned rho 0.4-3.4 s per process, held-out processes 66-93 s for 64 targets)
design.within_segment_order: make_schedule.py's seeded shuffles (P: 2026102100 + s over the six IC processes and the 64 rho runs; H: 2026102200 + h; O: 2026102300 + b)

gates: isolated_bench Tier 1 counters per run: exit 0, no timeout, verified=1, binary digest unchanged, no memory events; contention flags recorded and reported, never used to drop rows

every IC process: verified cached table on the frozen base, 29,880,000 states, the requested canonicalizer and order reported in summary and every record, no start override, Feistel bijection self-test passed, full-scan index build, five phases sum to each online interval, setup ends before the first online interval
primary exactness on every point: pL reproduces pB's probes and relation; pF, pLF, pLFaa and pX have identical probes and relation (lift_scan is exact, so the canonicalizer never changes the search)
one scalar per primary point across all six IC arms and the tuned rho; every scalar replays as [d]G = Q in the pinned oracle

old panels: every left-major arm reproduces the archived left-major probes and relation, every Feistel arm the archived Feistel ones, on Q0, the 16 fresh points and all 384 old held-out points; scalars equal the archived ones and replay; Q0 equals the validation sidecar
multiplicity: one primary (a conjunction of two bounds, which only lowers the false-improvement rate); controls are pass/fail gates; secondaries are reported, never decide

online.factor_log_table_policy: B's archived table; re-verified before any timing by ../koblitz-n83-reconcile-20261014/verify_log_table.py in the pinned pure-Python oracle; every IC process additionally verifies all [L_j]G = R_j before target work
online.old_heldout_targets_file: inputs/old_heldout_targets.json (role scanorder-heldout, seeds 0..383; regenerated and compared by make_targets.py)
online.online_interval: producer's own clock: target_query_begin .. recovery_check_end, five exclusive phases; the Feistel order and the canonicalizer run inside the interval; index build, log-table load and verification, the order's bijection self-test and process launch are outside
online.primary_targets_file: inputs/primary_targets.json (make_targets.py; role combined-primary-v1, seeds 0..575; new role, no scalar known, disjoint from Q0, the 16 fresh points and the 384 old held-out points)

power.population: the 384 old held-out targets' measured left-major and Feistel full-scan online times (run 38786433493) and the 16 per-point full / lift_scan ratios (run 38776966036), inputs/power_prior.json; timing noise sigma 0.02
power.reading: R_m is powered near 1 at every size tried; R_g, the geometric-mean ratio, is the binding statistic (expected 1.27 against 1.45 for R_m), so the panel is sized for the rule's conjunction. If the order effect were only 1.30 on means (stress scenario) the rule would have much lower power; that scenario is reported, not sized for.
power.rule: power - 2 * sqrt(power * (1 - power) / trials) >= 0.80, measured scenario, both bounds

question: Does the combination of the two measured, promoted n=83 K600 one-target IC improvements, the lift_scan target canonicalizer (cuts ns/probe, probes unchanged) and the Feistel scan order (cuts probes), lower the one-target online time below the better of the two single changes, on new public points?

sources.crypto_770f6a69: 770f6a6925a0d29b768bd79074f54a173e967fe7 (snapshots/r770 via ../koblitz-n83-reconcile-20261014/restore_sources.py, checked against that protocol's r770 digests)

statistics.S: S_rho = (mean IC online ms / tuned-rho ms per walk step) / sqrt(r), ms per step = median over all rT runs of online_ms / walk_steps; S_probe = mean probes / sqrt(r); for pB, pL, pF and pLF, with the delta of pLF against the better single arm and against B
statistics.aa: pLF / pLFaa, ratio of means, seed 2026102530
statistics.also_reported: combined vs each single arm and vs B (means and geometric means, seeds 2026102510-2026102519), probe ratios, per-arm summaries and mean probes / law; a bootstrap of R_m over the 64-point slices (sensitivity to process-level effects, seed 2026102550)
statistics.bootstrap: random.Random(seed); 10,000 resamples with replacement of the primary points; the statistic is recomputed per resample, including which single arm is better; sorted; 95% interval = indices 250 and 9749
statistics.planted: pX / pLF, ratio of means, seed 2026102532
statistics.primary: R_m = min(mean pL, mean pF) / mean pLF (ratio of means) and R_g = min(gm pL, gm pF) / gm pLF (ratio of geometric means), online_ms over all 576 primary points; seeds 2026102500 and 2026102501
statistics.rho_gap: tuned rho / IC per arm on the same primary points, means and geometric means (seeds 2026102560-2026102567)
statistics.secondaries: old 384 held-out panel: R_m, R_g and combined vs B (seeds 2026102600-2026102607); Q0 + 16 fresh: block-1 R_m, R_g and combined vs B (2026102610-2026102613), Q0 per-block times and probes

success_criterion: AGENTS.md 'Success criterion: iterative improvement of the index-calculus baseline' (PR #919): a verified, measured improvement over the current IC baseline under a protocol frozen before timing; each landed improvement becomes the new baseline with its delta.
